title: Book Two · Chapter 45: Mei's Pencil
story:
On Wednesday, Mei puts the book cards in a small box. Another child sits beside her with the class list.

Ronan stands near the shelf. His job is to put the books in order. He can clear the low space and put each book in its right place.

There is one pencil on the desk between them.

Ronan reaches for it.

“I can write the first name.”

“That's my part today,” Mei says.

Mei puts the pencil beside her hand.

Ronan takes his hand back. He looks at the books instead. Two small ones lean under a taller cover. He moves the tall one to the next space.

Miss Wu brings a short paper to the desk.

“Returned books here,” she says. She points to the left. “Checked books here.” She points to the right.

Mei moves a little square of card to each side. Ronan can read both marks.

“The right side goes to the shelf?” he asks.

“Yes,” Miss Wu says. “Leave the others for the card check.”

A child brings a small book back. Mei asks for the name. The other helper finds its card. Mei writes the date and puts the book on the right.

Ronan takes it to the shelf.

That part is easy. He comes back for another. The next book has a green cover. There is a goat on the front.

“I know this one.”

He opens it. Its card is still inside the front cover. She is checking a name on the class list.

“Wait. I still need—” she begins.

“Where are the animal books?” another child asks Ronan.

He turns toward the shelf with the green book. He puts it in the short stories. The card stays inside the closed cover.

Then he shows the animal shelf to the child. There is room at the front for a small picture book.

Mei looks up from the list. Two more children bring books to her desk. She calls the other helper to check the next title.

Ronan returns to his own space. He puts several long books together. One falls against his elbow. He catches it before it reaches the floor.

Jun comes past with his school bag.

“Busy?”

“Very.”

Jun looks at the empty place on the shelf.

“You can put that big one flat.”

Ronan tries it. The book fits. Its title is still clear.

“Like that?”

“Yes.”

Jun goes back to his seat. Ronan stays by the shelf for a moment. He is pleased Jun spoke to him first today.

At the end, Mei closes the card box. Her fingers have a little pencil dust on them. Ronan has dust on his sleeve.

“Is yours finished?” he asks.

“For now,” she says.

He looks at the pencil again. Mei puts it inside the box. Ronan carries the empty book tray to the cupboard.

Miss Wu asks the class to sit down. The helpers leave the desk clear. Ronan can see the green goat between two story books. He straightens the cover once, then goes to his seat.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

card＝卡片；checked＝核对过的；shelf＝架子；pencil＝铅笔。

## 理解问题

1. Mei和Ronan分别负责什么？
2. 绿书和它的卡片最后一起去了哪里？

## 读句子

**Mei / puts the pencil / beside her hand.** Mei／把铅笔放下／放在手边。
